DC Metro 2026 Hole-N-One Challenge

2026 DC Metro Hole-N-One Challenge

Take your shot at the season-long ACE POT!

Current Hole-N-One Pot

$500.00

Current Partitipants Click Here

Challenge Highlights

$25 Buy-In

Join the challenge anytime throughout the season.

Make an Ace

If you record a Hole-N-One during the season you become eligible to win the pot.

Season Finale

The pot pays out at the DC Metro Tour Championship at Penn National.

Growing Pot

The balance continues to grow throughout the entire season.

Challenge Rules
  • $25 buy-in anytime throughout the season.
  • The Hole-N-One Pot remains a running balance throughout the year.
  • If a player makes a Hole-N-One during the season they win the pot at the end of the season.
  • If multiple players make a Hole-N-One, the pot will be split among the winners.
  • Payout will occur at the DC Metro Tour Championship at Penn National Golf Club.
  • Payout methods: Cash, Venmo, or CashApp.
  • Players must be DC Metro Tour members to be eligible.
  • Guests are ineligible unless they pay the $25 entry before checking into the event.

If No Hole-N-One Occurs

For tax purposes the DC Metro Tour cannot carry the pot into the following season.

50% of the pot will be donated to the DC Metro Tour Stand-Up-2-Cancer Campaign.

50% of the pot will be divided and raffled to two players who paid into the challenge.

Enter the Challenge

Entry payments can be made via:

Venmo 

or

Zelle @

DCMetro@amateurgolftour.net

Please include a note stating:
"2026 Hole-N-One Challenge"

DC Metro Golfweek Amateur Tour  -  2026 Hole-N-One Challenge
